card_summary: Drier climate: sea-surface humidity, evaporation and ocean supply each cut ~30%; mountains lowered via peak override back to its default 4000 m.

events.transcript_tail:
Choose what to do, type a request, and press Send. The reply is shown here; nothing is saved until you press Save to note.
You
Make the climate drier and the mountains lower.
Looked up 8 matching actions first (about 508 tokens).
The model is reading the climate, weather, world settings…
MODEL PROPOSAL
“Drier climate: sea-surface humidity, evaporation and ocean supply each cut ~30%; mountains lowered via peak override back to its default 4000 m.”
Peak override (optional)  (peak_m)   5182 m  ->  4000 m   -23%   (default 4000 m)
    “Lower the peak override from ~5182 m to its default 4000 m for lower mountains and relief.”  (model's words)
Sea-surface humidity  (climate.ocean_hum)   1.00  ->  0.70   -30%
    “Cut sea-surface humidity by 30% (1.0 → 0.7) for drier air over the sea.”  (model's words)
Evaporation  (climate.evap)   0.12  ->  0.08   -30%
    “Lower evaporation by 30% (0.12 → 0.084) so less moisture is picked up over the sea.”  (model's words)
Ocean supply  (climate.ocean)   1.00 ×  ->  0.70 ×   -30%
    “Cut the global rain budget by 30% (1.0 → 0.7) for a drier world overall.”  (model's words)
4 settings refresh the climate with Recompute in the status bar.
Applying changes the settings, then refreshes the climate. The world itself is not replaced.
[Dismiss]
[Apply and regenerate]
